Congrats on signing; excited to get Aurora Health into production. To make the implementation smooth, can we lock a 90-minute kickoff workshop in the next two weeks to cover roles & responsibilities, network/security checklist, data flows, and a first 30/60/90 mutual action plan?

- Tue 2026-06-23 10:00–11:30 PDT
- Wed 2026-06-24 13:00–14:30 PDT
- Thu 2026-06-25 09:00–10:30 PDT

Suggested attendees (we can trim):
- Aurora: Sofie Lang (PM), IT lead, Security architect
- Redwood: Tessa Morgan (CS lead), Monica Patel (Implementation PM), Laura Bennett (Solutions Eng), Dev Patel (Account Exec)

Draft agenda (90 min):
1) Introductions & objectives (10)
2) Roles, milestones, success criteria (15)
3) Network & security checklist (20)
4) Integration plan & timeline (20)
5) Next steps: owners, calendar invites, docs (15)

I can send an invite once you confirm a preferred slot and final attendee list. I also attached a mutual action plan template and a placeholder drive folder for pre-reads.
